title: The Pre-Mortem Before the Launch
short_teaser: A pre-mortem asks a team to imagine that a plan has failed and then identify the likely reasons.
story: A pre-mortem asks a team to imagine that a plan has failed and then identify the likely reasons. This makes it easier to discuss risks before pride and momentum make them harder to name. Imagining failure can strengthen a plan when the purpose is preparation rather than pessimism. Strategy is the discipline of choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Imagining failure can strengthen a plan when the purpose is preparation rather than pessimism. Strategy is the discipline of choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
spark_application: Identify the decision underneath your current activity. Choose the smallest next move that would create useful information. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
